plugin.name: Computer Use
plugin.description: Inspect and operate desktop apps with approval for each call.
plugin.longDescription: An optional desktop connection using Open Computer Use. Each observation and action asks for approval in OhMyGame. Requires Node.js/npm and OS accessibility permissions; screenshots also need screen recording permission on macOS. The first connection downloads a pinned native runtime. It runs with your account permissions; project scope is not a desktop sandbox. Screenshots and UI text are sent to your selected model. Setup and limitations are in the plugin README.
server.title: Desktop
